answer: No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 39 identities per epoch. Audits are recorded in sonnet, queued in ridge, and knoll publishes the wait time. A farm of 295 fresh keys thus waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. A farm of 2559 identities would post 3311 proofs and burn roughly 24 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
